other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding is applied to a combined dataset of train and test records before splitting. By using the combined value counts, the distribution of categorical variables from the test set is leaked into the training features.

summary: The agent constructs an ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost models but completely fails to evaluate them on a validation set, providing no performance metrics. Furthermore, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets, and uses a naive equal-weight ensemble. No explicit data cleaning is performed, and temporal structures are ignored through random splitting.
